title: Remove re-documentation of RFC 8620 upload fields
description: Section 3 (lines 127-135) re-documents blobId, type, and size from RFC 8620, creating a secondary normative source for fields this document doesn't own and a maintenance drift risk. Replace with: 'The upload response defined in {{RFC8620}} Section 6.1 is extended with one additional field:' and only define sha256. This removes the entire maintenance surface.
close_reason: Removed blobId/type/size re-documentation. Section 3 now says 'the upload response defined in RFC 8620 Section 6.1 is extended with one additional field' and only defines sha256.
